ExternalEpfWaitResult.description: Observed outcome of an opt-in bounded external EPF client launch.

LaunchPlan.description:
Compact machine-facing plan produced by a non-executing launch preview.

The plan names what the runner selected, because only the runner discovers a
platform installation: a caller cannot compose these arguments itself.

args.description: Composed arguments with every credential value masked.

program.description: Program the runner would have spawned.

McpReadinessResult.description: Result of probing a client-side MCP endpoint after launch.

missing_tools.description: Required tool names that were not returned by `tools/list`.

ok.description: `true` when initialize and tools/list succeeded and required tools were present.

PlatformResolution.description: Canonical platform installation metadata exposed by `launch` JSON results.

installation_root.description: Absolute canonical root shared by platform utilities from this installation.

path.description: Absolute canonical path to the selected executable.

source.description: Discovery source used for the selected executable.

version.description: Platform version inferred from the canonical installation path, when known.

PlatformResolutionSource.description: Typed discovery sources exposed by `launch` resolution metadata.

oneOf.description: The configured utility or installation hint.
A directory captured from `PATH` when the locator was created.

binary.description: Selected binary path used to spawn the process; for `web` — the system URL opener.

external_epf_wait.description: Direct external EPF wait outcome when explicitly requested.

mcp_readiness.description: Client-side MCP endpoint readiness details when readiness was requested.

ok.description: `true` when the process was spawned successfully.

pid.description: OS process identifier if the launcher exposed one.

plan.description: Compact machine-facing plan produced by a non-executing preview.

platform_resolution.description:
Canonical platform installation metadata for the selected binary. Absent for
`web`: a browser is not a platform utility.

provider_dispatched.description: `false` when the run stopped at a preview instead of dispatching the client process.
